kite_map.doc: The Kite's world map (KiteMapMenu, M3-UI-205; SPEC 6.6). Rects x, y, w, h at the 1920 x 1080 reference, multiples of 3, centred. Left: the places (rows, max_rows before it scrolls; Search and Leave last) and the line about the highlighted row (desc). Right: the chart (KiteChart): the grid's cell lines at grid_alpha, column letters label_pad above it and row numbers row_label_px left of it, region names, a gem_px gem per place gem_offset_px under its region's name, the cursor ring ring_gap_px outside the gem, and the searched cell outlined, both cursor_px wide.
